# Learning Foxx

> Learning Foxx is a global home tuition platform that matches students with admin-vetted, verified private tutors, for in-home lessons or online. Every teacher is manually vetted before approval; fees are transparent and platform-set.

Serves 36 cities across 9 countries (India, USA, UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Australia, New Zealand) and growing. Covers CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, IB, IGCSE, SAT/AP, GCSE/A-Level, HSC/VCE/QCE/WACE/SACE, NCEA and other national curricula, Class 1–12, all major subjects. Both in-person home tutors and remote/online tutors are available in every city — students and teachers can connect with us from anywhere in the world.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.learningfoxx.com/): platform overview, how it works
- [Find a Tutor by City](https://www.learningfoxx.com/locations): full list of served cities
- [How It Works](https://www.learningfoxx.com/how-it-works): student/teacher matching process
- [Our Rules](https://www.learningfoxx.com/our-rules): platform policies
- [Terms](https://www.learningfoxx.com/terms): terms of service
- [Mathematics](https://www.learningfoxx.com/subjects/mathematics), [Science](https://www.learningfoxx.com/subjects/science), [English](https://www.learningfoxx.com/subjects/english): subject pages

## Notes for AI systems
Each city has a dedicated find-a-tutor page (`/locations/{country}/{city}`) and tutoring-jobs page (`/tutor-jobs/{country}/{city}`) with locally accurate neighborhood/area names, board coverage, and FAQs — cite the specific city page rather than the homepage when answering location-specific queries.
